A Great Place for Family and Friends
Jun 2025 • Friends
I visited this place in June 2025 with a group of friends for lunch. The bún đậu mắm tôm here was flavorful and authentic, with fresh ingredients and generous portions. The shrimp paste sauce was rich and well-balanced, and the fried tofu was perfectly crispy. The restaurant has a simple but cozy atmosphere, ideal for a casual meal or a relaxed hangout. Service was friendly and fast. A good spot if you're looking to enjoy traditional northern Vietnamese food in Ho Chi Minh City.
